risks.risk: Tenant store closure risk — subject store could fall inside JACK on Track 150–200-store cull (franchise agreement termination path)
risks.mitigant: Obtain estoppel certificate + tenant solvency review; ask for renewal commitment; if no renewal, market the asset 12–18 months ahead of expiry. Verify whether subject store is company- or franchisee-operated and identify the guarantor.

risks.risk: Lease expiry value cliff — NNN asset value decays as remaining term shortens; at <5 years remaining, buyers demand deep discounts
risks.mitigant: Initiate renewal negotiation ≥24 months before expiry; if renewal fails, list by 2028–2029 while ≥6–8 years of term remain. Do not let the term quietly run down.

risks.risk: Cap-rate expansion / rate volatility (10Y at 4.90%; net-lease avg cap 6.9%) compresses sale proceeds
risks.mitigant: Stress-test sale at +50/100 bps cap expansion; compare vs PV of renewed rent stream; consider 1031 exchange; time sale to rate dips; obtain multiple broker opinions of value (non-binding).

risks.risk: LA County population decline (DOF: −1.5% by 2035; −9.1% by 2060) and flat retail demand
risks.mitigant: Infill density (8,304/sq mi city) and drive-through formats outperform; monitor trade-area sales; focus on rent bump at renewal rather than market rent growth assumptions.

risks.risk: Tenant sales deterioration (system SSS −4.2% FY2025; −1.1% Q3 FY2026) pressures franchisees and rent coverage
risks.mitigant: Require sales reporting under the lease (if it grants it), monitor quarterly JACK results, confirm percentage rent (if any), verify insurance and tax payments current.

risks.risk: Property tax escalation after change of ownership (Prop 13 base reset — LA County base 1% + voter bonds; effective rate varies)
risks.mitigant: In NNN the tenant bears taxes, but a reset can stress tenant coverage — factor into renewal negotiation and lease-clause review. No parcel-specific rate published; confirm with LA County Assessor (not verified this session).

risks.risk: Insurance market hardening in California (FAIR Plan growth reported; premiums rising post-2025 fires)
risks.mitigant: NNN shifts insurance to tenant; obtain certificates annually; confirm tenant carries L&I + property per lease; confirm landlord is additional insured. FAIR Plan stats are REPORTED, not verified — flagged.

risks.risk: Vacancy/re-leasing downtime at expiry if tenant exits (QSR space has limited alternative uses; entitlement friction)
risks.mitigant: Begin renewal talks 24–36 months early; pre-qualify alternate QSR covenants; understand demolition/redevelopment value as floor (land residual).

risks.risk: Major earthquake (Puente Hills blind thrust — full-rupture loss scenario $82B–$252B)
risks.mitigant: Confirm seismic retrofit status (LA URM/non-ductile concrete ordinances), tenant insurance + loss-payee, landlord loss-of-rents endorsement; 1994 Northridge (M6.7, 57 deaths) as calibration; verify parcel seismic zone (ZIMAS) — flagged, not verified.

risks.risk: Wildfire / smoke / regional disaster economics (Jan 2025 Eaton & Palisades: 16,256 structures destroyed region-wide) depressing Central LA retail and insurance availability
risks.mitigant: Central LA parcel is outside burn scars but shares insurer repricing and regional demand shocks; require tenant insurance verification; monitor CDI actions; confirm no smoke-damage/business-interruption exposure for the tenant.

risks.risk: Recession with LA-specific labor weakness (LA MSA unemployment 4.4% vs US 4.2%; CA 5.1%; payrolls flat ~6.30M)
risks.mitigant: QSR value segment is recession-resilient but ticket-splitting hurts; stress-test 10% rent sensitivity; preserve liquidity; avoid over-leveraging the asset with proceeds.

risks.risk: Tenant credit event — JACK insolvency or distressed exchange (stock $100→$28 FY2020–FY2025; activist campaign; poison pill)
risks.mitigant: Escalation rights & guarantees review; if corporate lease, monitor 8-Ks; consider requiring corporate guarantee renewal or security deposit increase at renewal; consider early sale if credit inflects down.

risks.risk: Civil unrest / property damage events (historical 1992 Central LA unrest relevance)
risks.mitigant: NNN passes repair cost to tenant; verify tenant riot/civil commotion insurance; consider landlord policy review; keep tenant relations strong.

risks.risk: Concentration risk — single-tenant, single-asset, single-market exposure; no diversification
risks.mitigant: Size position as % of net worth; compare 1031 into diversified DST/REIT or multi-tenant retail; keep ≥6–12 months liquidity post-any-sale.

options.name: Option A — Sell before expiry (2026–2028 window)
options.notes: Captures remaining-term premium; crystalizes gain (capital gains + depreciation recapture); redeploys into diversified assets (1031). Risk: selling into 4.9% 10Y / 6.9% net-lease cap environment locks in today's pricing; loses renewal rent bump and long-term inflation hedge.

options.name: Option B — Renew at expiry / hold long-term (2030–2035+)
options.notes: Preserves NNN passive income; renewal bump (typically +10–20% for QSR NNN, per industry practice — VERIFY against lease comps) resets basis value; Prop 13 shields basis; tenant bears OpEx inflation. Risk: tenant credit deterioration; term runs down if renewal fails; concentration persists.

options.name: Option C — Hybrid: negotiate renewal/extension now + keep sale optionality
options.notes: Negotiate extension option or early renewal with escalator reset (e.g., +10% bump then 8–10% stacked 5-yr bumps — illustrative, verify w/ lease), simultaneously commission broker opinions of value and keep the asset market-ready. Revisit trigger points quarterly (tenant SSS, cap rates, LA DOF estimates).
